status_note: Twelve bounded Wave C adapters (2D convex hull, polygon properties and containment, 2D/constrained/3D Delaunay triangulation, kd-tree k-NN and radius search, Bbox_2/Bbox_3, AABB closest points and ray first hits) and eleven mandatory independent validators are VALIDATED in the formal official-CGAL 6.2.1 worker and the MCP auto/legacy publication paths. They were verified by the repository's own cases and MCP end-to-end tests and have not had a separate independent native review. This does not complete any original family.
